The Audi A2 is BACK… But is it as groundbreaking as the original?
Introducing the all-new Audi A2 e-tron!
Audi has brought back the A2, and it’s set to replace the Audi A1 and Audi Q2!
The question is: can this all-new Audi live up to the reputation of the original A2? And does it offer enough appeal over competitors like the Kia EV3 and Volvo EX30? Let’s take a closer look, starting with the design…
